sample_definition: mean ns per command over a timed chunk of consecutive commands
machine: Intel Core i5-9300H (4C/8T, 2.4 GHz base), 7.8 GB RAM, Windows 11 Home 10.0.26200, AC power, Balanced power mode, 7 idle Docker containers

workloads.name: rest_insert
workloads.description: non-crossing limit joins an existing level (100 levels x 10 orders per side)

workloads.name: cross
workloads.description: crossing limit fully fills exactly one maker (10,000 one-lot asks)

workloads.name: cancel
workloads.description: cancel a random resting order (20,000 resting, 100 per level)

workloads.name: amend
workloads.description: amend a random order: 50% size-down in place, 50% re-price (20,000 resting)

workloads.name: partial_fill
workloads.description: crossing limit partially fills a large maker at the head of the queue

workloads.name: sweep
workloads.description: market order sweeps 10 levels x 5 orders (50 fills)

workloads.name: mixed
workloads.description: synthetic mix of limit/IOC/market/cancel/amend after 20,000-command warm-up
